New suite test_refactor_regression.py 12/12 PASS covering supplier sync refactor (fetch_with_retry 3 attempts + failed run/health=error, upsert new/updated counts, duplicate_count via colliding map_id -> 1 new + 3 dup, supplier_cost price_history, locked selling price NOT overwritten, supplier_cost/stock refreshed, unlocked+markup recalculates price with selling_price history, re-import skipped, 3 sync runs recorded), OpenAPI read (no URL 400, HTML 400 'Could not read spec as JSON', JSON w/o paths 200), CSV/XLSX import (case-insensitive name grouping into plans, bad price row + missing name reported with row numbers, brand/category auto-created and reused case-insensitively, xlsx float price, .txt 400), order transition/deliver invalid -> 400 with detail, empty delivery 422, unknown order 404, Telegram CALLBACKS dispatch (x: cancels intent and later c: creates nothing; b: creates bot intent; c: creates AWAITING_PAYMENT order; pm: rejected for other chat, sets payment_method_id + await_evidence session for owner chat; text evidence -> PAYMENT_SUBMITTED; unknown kind / bad b: / bad pm: handled; non-owner a: audited; duplicate update_id ignored). Frontend (Playwright 1920): Home hero logo + 4 FAQ accordion; catalog search debounced (1 request for 7 keystrokes), URL sync, empty state, min price/in-stock/promo filters and clear; Support 4 contacts + 4 FAQ; product page Messenger dialog creates ref, copy button puts summary w/ ref in clipboard, track link -> /track auto-lookup shows status; bad token shows error; Settings FAQ add -> save -> reload persists -> remove -> save persists; sidebar nav filtered for owner/customer_service/product_manager and direct /admin/users shows no-permission; Order detail full flow (Customer confirmed -> add evidence reference -> approve via confirm dialog -> delivery form -> toast 'awaiting_manual_handoff', timeline 5 events). No page errors. Found only minor issues (3 unhandled 500s on malformed input, FAQ _k key leaking into DB).

minor.issue: Sending "description": null returns 500 (TypeError: it.description[:200] on None in suppliers.import_products). Also sp.get('image','').startswith would 500 if image is stored as null. Use (it.description or '') and (sp.get('image') or '').
Corrupt .xlsx (not a zip) -> 500 (openpyxl BadZipFile) and non-UTF8 .csv -> 500 (UnicodeDecodeError) in parse_sheet. Wrap parsing in try/except and raise HTTPException(400, 'Could not read file').

Settings.jsx adds a client-only `_k` React key to every FAQ item and sends it on save; backend stores it as-is (faq items now contain q_en,q_my,a_en,a_my,_k). Strip `_k` in the frontend before PUT or validate FAQ items with a Pydantic model server-side. (I restored the original FAQ in DB after the test.)
Unescaped callback data is used in a Mongo $regex (`^{pid}`); 'b::' or regex metachars match any published product. Use re.escape(pid) and require len(pid)==8.
Sleeps 2**attempt even after the final failed attempt (adds a useless 4s to every failed sync request).

issues: Status chip shows English label ('Awaiting customer confirmation') while rest of page is Myanmar - consider localized status label.
FAQ question/answer inputs and the 'Remove' button have no data-testid (tests rely on placeholders/role).

telegram handle_update only catches OrderError; any other exception in a handler bubbles up to the webhook (Telegram will retry the update, but the update_id is already recorded so the retry is dropped as duplicate -> update silently lost). Consider catching Exception, logging, and returning ok.
